name: StatusCake
author: Robin van der Knaap
description: StatusCake uptime check counts in the bar, with a popup listing every check

barWidget.description: Up/down counts for your StatusCake uptime checks, with a popup listing each check and its uptime.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll the StatusCake API. Lower values burn through your API rate limit faster.

schema.label: Tags
schema.description: Optional comma-separated tag list. Leave empty to count every uptime check on the account.

schema.label: Match any tag
schema.description: When on, include checks carrying any of the tags above instead of only those carrying all of them.

schema.label: Notify on state changes
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a check flips up to down, or back.
